product_one_liner.value: Aviso AI provides an AI revenue intelligence and execution platform that helps sales and go-to-market teams forecast revenue, guide deals and coordinate selling actions.
product_one_liner.notes: The homepage identifies modern GTM teams as the audience, while the company descriptions specify forecasting, deal guidance and coordinated sales actions: https://www.aviso.com/, https://jobs.scalevp.com/companies/aviso/jobs/74420347-senior-data-scientist and https://www.aviso.com/careers/software-enginner.

pricing_page.notes: A public, navigation-linked pricing page advertises flexible per-user plans and tailored proposals. Dollar prices are not published: https://www.aviso.com/pricing.

named_customers.notes: named_customers: Aviso publishes customer case studies naming New Relic and Honeywell: https://www.aviso.com/case-study/new-relic-chooses-aviso-ai-for-accurate-forecasting-of-its-consumption-based-revenue and https://www.aviso.com/case-study/why-did-honeywell-choose-aviso-for-ai-sales-guidance. | named_customers.0: The case study expressly states that New Relic selected Aviso: https://www.aviso.com/case-study/new-relic-chooses-aviso-ai-for-accurate-forecasting-of-its-consumption-based-revenue. | named_customers.1: Aviso publishes a customer case study about Honeywell's use of its sales guidance: https://www.aviso.com/case-study/why-did-honeywell-choose-aviso-for-ai-sales-guidance.

employee_band.notes: The company's LinkedIn profile publicly lists 201–500 employees: https://about.linkedin.com/company/aviso-inc. This is a reported company-size band, not an independently audited headcount.

hq_location.notes: hq_city: Both the company's announcement and its LinkedIn profile explicitly identify Redwood City as headquarters: https://www.aviso.com/press/aviso-achieves-record-high-accuracy-rates-for-ai-powered-sales-predictions and https://about.linkedin.com/company/aviso-inc. | hq_country: The company announcement identifies its headquarters as Redwood City, California, and its LinkedIn address explicitly identifies the country as US: https://www.aviso.com/press/aviso-achieves-record-high-accuracy-rates-for-ai-powered-sales-predictions and https://linkedin.com/company/3713385.

founded_year.notes: Aviso's own announcement explicitly states that it was founded in 2012: https://www.aviso.com/press/aviso-achieves-record-high-accuracy-rates-for-ai-powered-sales-predictions. This primary-source statement is preferred over the conflicting 2014 date on LinkedIn.

eng_blog.notes: The readable blog index is predominantly sales, product and buyer-oriented content. The technical-looking posts reviewed are credited to a Research & Content Manager rather than an engineer; two qualifying engineer-authored implementation posts were not established. Sources: https://www.aviso.com/blog and https://www.aviso.com/blog/author/bithika-bishesh.

public_docs.notes: The public help center exposes multiple documentation entries, including Accounts, Activity & RI, Customer Success, Hierarchy Management and User Management: https://dochelp.aviso.com/en_US/welcome-to-aviso-ai/get-started-with-aviso-ai.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The live official careers list contains no qualifying AI, ML or data-science title; its Data Engineer role does not count. The previously advertised Senior Data Scientist position explicitly no longer accepts applications: https://www.aviso.com/careers and https://jobs.scalevp.com/companies/aviso/jobs/74420347-senior-data-scientist.

model_provider.notes: Aviso explicitly says it added GPT functionality to its platform. The answer does not infer a particular GPT version or hosting provider: https://www.aviso.com/press/aviso-combines-generative-ai-with-its-conversational-deal-and-revenue-intelligence-capabilities-to-power-the-next-generation-of-b2b-content-creation.

compliance_certs.notes: compliance_certs: The compliance page names all four standards, explicitly describes ISO 27001 certification, a SOC 2 Type II audit and a completed GDPR assessment, and names PCI DSS Service Provider Level 1 in its AWS-hosted service compliance statement. These are public claims, not independent verification of separate attestations: https://www.aviso.com/compliance-at-aviso-ai. | compliance_certs.0: Aviso describes a SOC 2 Type II audit of its platform: https://www.aviso.com/compliance-at-aviso-ai. | compliance_certs.1: Aviso explicitly states that it is ISO 27001 certified: https://www.aviso.com/compliance-at-aviso-ai. | compliance_certs.2: Aviso claims a completed GDPR internal assessment and compliance review; this is a compliance claim rather than a separately named formal certification: https://www.aviso.com/compliance-at-aviso-ai. | compliance_certs.3: PCI DSS Service Provider Level 1 is named in the AWS-hosted service compliance statement; a separate Aviso-specific attestation was not verified: https://www.aviso.com/compliance-at-aviso-ai.

last_funding.notes: funding_stage: The latest identified primary financing is classified as Angel by CB Insights and Angel (individual) by PitchBook. The later secondary share transaction is excluded from company fundraising: https://www.cbinsights.com/company/aviso/financials and https://pitchbook.com/profiles/company/57271-24. | funding_date: Both profiles place the latest identified primary fundraising in November 2020. Their one-day date difference does not affect YYYY-MM. PitchBook's later June 2025 transaction is explicitly secondary, not a new company capital raise: https://www.cbinsights.com/company/aviso/financials and https://pitchbook.com/profiles/company/57271-24. | funding_amount_usd: Neither public funding table supplies an amount for the November 2020 angel investment, so the amount remains unknown rather than borrowing an older round's amount: https://www.cbinsights.com/company/aviso/financials and https://pitchbook.com/profiles/company/57271-24.

raised_18mo.notes: The latest identified primary funding round is dated November 2020, outside the requested 18-month window. The June 2025 event is explicitly a secondary transaction, not capital raised by Aviso: https://www.cbinsights.com/company/aviso/financials and https://pitchbook.com/profiles/company/57271-24. No recent primary-financing announcement was verified.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The live Account Executive posting identifies an open US role and provides an application form; its publication date is November 2, 2026: https://www.aviso.com/careers/us/account-executive-1.

launched_6mo.notes: Aviso introduced its autonomous AI CSM on June 16, 2026, within the requested six-month window. Managing digital customer accounts end-to-end is a substantive product launch, not a UI tweak: https://www.aviso.com/blog/introducing-aicsm-by-aviso.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Unknown. The current roster at https://www.aviso.com/about lists leaders without joining dates. The dated profiles and announcements reviewed did not establish a qualifying hire or departure, nor sufficiently complete employment histories to confidently rule one out.

crm_stack_signal.notes: crm_stack_signal: The integrations page explicitly names all six systems.
